# Genome AI
> Engineer AI behavior with Digital DNA — structured, versioned, measurable genomes instead of prompt-only design.

Genome AI is a web product for designing, benchmarking, and versioning AI behavior profiles (genomes) composed of tunable genes.

- Home: https://genomeai.space/
- Learn (guides): https://genomeai.space/learn/

- Pricing: https://genomeai.space/pricing/
